description: XAGs where current+existing+proposed all pass strict QCEC equivalence. Regenerated 2026-06-04 from the deterministic-RNG sweep (RandomXAG bounded()/Fisher-Yates fix) on Ubuntu gcc+libstdc++, qiskit 2.4.1 + mqt.qcec. SUPERSEDES CI run #23 (commit eab47c6): those tuples were produced by the old platform-dependent RNG and now generate different circuits. 21 of 42 sweep tuples pass; the remaining 21 fail (19 proposed-method not_equivalent, 2 all-method statevector mismatches) — see PR notes. Used by CIQCVerification as a regression gate; confirm against the CI matrix before relying on it.
